# FQHETorusShowBasis

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnTorus` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnTorus/FQHETorusShowBasis`

```text
FQHETorusShowBasis, version 0.01

Usage: FQHETorusShowBasis [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 4)
    -l, --nbr-flux : number of flux quanta (default value = 8)
    -x, --kx-momentum : the total momentum along the x axis (only available when using magnetic translations, should be lower than GDC(p, l)) (default value = 0)
    -y, --ky-momentum : the total momentum along the y axis (default value = 0)
    --fermion : use fermionic statistic instead of bosonic statistic
    --boson : use bosonic statistics
    --su2-spin : consider particles with SU(2) spin
    --time-reversal : consider particles with SU(2) spin, with opposite magnetic fields for opposite spins
    --2-ll : consider particles with 2 Landau levels
    --3-ll : consider particles with 3 Landau levels
    -s, --total-sz : twice the z component of the total spin of the system (only useful in su(2) mode) (default value = 0)
    --su3-spin : consider particles with SU(3) spin
    --total-tz : twice the quantum number of the system associated to the Tz generator (only useful in su(3) mode) (default value = 0)
    --total-y : three time the quantum number of the system associated to the Y generator (only useful in su(3) mode) (default value = 0)
    --su4-spin : consider particles with SU(4) spin
    -i, --total-isosz : twice the z component of the total isospin of the system (only usefull in su(4) mode) (default value = 0)
    -e, --total-entanglement : twice the projection of the total spin-isopsin entanglement of the system (only usefull in su(4) mode) (default value = 0)
    --nbr-n1 : number of type 1 particles (only useful in su(3) mode) (default value = 0)
    --nbr-n2 : number of type 2 particles (only useful in su(3) mode) (default value = 0)
    --nbr-n3 : number of type 3 particles (only useful in su(3) mode) (default value = 0)
    --nbr-n4 : number of type 4 particles (only useful in su(4) mode) (default value = 0)
    --no-translation : do not consider magnetic translation (only trivial translations along one axis)
    --no-sz : assume that Sz is not conserved (only useful in su(2) mode)
    --use-sublattice : use the sublattice quantum number (for pair hopping model)
    --sublattice : for even number of sites, fix the sublattice particle number sector (negative if none) (default value = -1)
    --t2xt2 : consider particles on the T2xT2 geometry
    --nbrflux-2 : number of flux quanta for the second torus on the T2XT2 geometry (default value = 20)
    --kymomentum-2 : the total momentum along the y axis for the second torus when using the T2xT2 geometry (default value = 0)
    --t2t2-hardcorenonn : consider particles on the T2xT2 geometry, with hardcore contraint and no nearest neighbor
    --t2xs2 : consider particles on the T2xS2 geometry
    --t2s2-hardcorenonn : consider particles on the T2xS2 geometry, with hardcore contraint and no nearest neighbor
    --state : name of an optional vector state whose component values can be displayed behind each corresponding n-body state
    --hide-component : hide state components (and thus the corresponding n-body state) whose absolute value is lower than a given error (0 if all components have to be shown (default value = 0)
    --pauli : print only states obeying a general Pauli exclusion principle

output options:
    --save-disk : save output on disk
    --output-file : use this file name instead of statistics_sphere_n_nbrparticles_q_nbrfluxquanta_z_totallz.basis

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
